articles.title: Securitize remains in the red even as record quarter fuels public listing plans
articles.snippet: The tokenization platform reported record quarterly revenue but continued to post losses as it invested in growth and public-company preparations tied to its merger with Cantor Equity Partners II.

articles.title: Latest Congressional swing at crypto tax reform would direct IRS to review de minimis exemptions
articles.snippet: The newest version of the Parity Act updates language around payment stablecoins and directs the IRS to report on how a de minimis exemption might work.

articles.title: Prediction markets firms take heat in Senate Commerce hearing scrutinizing surge
articles.snippet: Sports betting on firms such as Kalshi was the focus of questions over advertising to children, cheating from athletes and undermining regulated gaming.

articles.title: Crypto custody firm Copper is looking to sell the company for $500 million
articles.snippet: Cantor Fitzgerald has been appointed to help with the sale, according to sources.
